## 6. Review and acceptance

6.1 Client will appoint **[name/role]** as the authorized approver. Lextel will submit each deliverable for review through **[email/project tool]**.

6.2 Client will review each deliverable against the acceptance criteria in this SOW and provide written acceptance or a single consolidated list of specific material non-conformities within **[number] business days** after submission.

6.3 Lextel will address verified non-conformities within **[number] business days** or an agreed schedule and resubmit the deliverable. Client will review the correction within **[number] business days**.

6.4 **[Choose and complete: If Client does not respond by the review deadline, the deliverable is deemed accepted / lack of response is not acceptance and the Parties will agree on next steps.]** New requests or preferences that do not reflect a stated acceptance criterion will be handled through change control.

## 9. Change control

Either Party may submit a written change request describing the requested change and reason. Lextel will provide an impact assessment for scope, deliverables, fees, schedule, dependencies, and risks. Work on the change begins only after both Parties sign a change order. Until then, the current SOW remains in effect.
